title: Ultra Roasted Slovakian Wagyu Dumplings
description: A kid-friendly Slovakian dish featuring roasted Wagyu beef and chewy dumplings, made with plant-based friendly ingredients and caramelized to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground Wagyu beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Gradually add the all-purpose flour to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides.
Transfer the dumplings to a baking dish and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the dumplings are roasting, heat the vegetable broth in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Remove the dumplings from the oven and brush with the hot vegetable broth.
